subject: Decision Making
title: Evolutionary Game Theory
description: A fast breakdown of Evolutionary Game Theory for builders.

hook.text: Animals cannot do math, but their behavior looks like game theory. Evolution selects strategies that survive.

buildup.text: Hawks always fight. Doves always share. In a mixed population, the stable ratio depends on the costs of fighting.

discovery.text: Evolution finds Nash equilibria through natural selection. Strategies that do well reproduce. Bad strategies go extinct.

twist.text: Human morality may be an evolved strategy. Fairness, reciprocity, and punishment all help groups survive and cooperate.

climax.text: Evolutionary game theory shows that strategic behavior predates consciousness.

punchline.text: Evolution plays game theory. Nature finds equilibria without doing any math.

quiz.question: How does evolution relate to game theory?
options: Natural selection finds Nash equilibria by rewarding successful strategies
